                                           STIPULATION TO CONSOLIDATE RELATED ACTIONS, Case No. 3:25-cv-07947
      Case 3:25-cv-07947-CRB           Document 30      Filed 12/05/25        Page 7 of 14



 1          WHEREAS, the above-captioned Related Cases currently are pending in this District and
 2 concern substantially the same parties, property, transaction, or event;

 3          WHEREAS, the above-captioned matter, McPhee v. Prosper Funding, LLC, was the first-
 4   filed and is the furthest along, procedurally, among the Related Cases;
 5          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that this Stipulation is being entered into without waiving
 6   any party’s rights or ability to raise any defenses or claims (including jurisdictional challenges)
 7   and expressly reserve all rights regarding the same;
 8          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that the Related Cases should be consolidated for pre-trial
 9   purposes in the interests of efficiency and judicial economy, and to avoid unnecessary duplication
10   of effort and resources. Accordingly, all counsel for the Parties to the Related Cases jointly
11   stipulate and request that the Court enter an Order consolidating the Related Cases for pre-trial
12   purposes and permitting the filing of a single Consolidated Class Action Complaint; and
13          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that it would be duplicative and wasteful of the Court’s and
14   the Parties’ resources for Defendants to be required to separately respond to the complaints in the
15   Related Actions prior to the filing of a Consolidated Class Action Complaint, should the Court
16   order the requested consolidation;
17          NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS STIPULATED AND AGREED, and the Parties request,
18   that the Court order the following:
19          1.      The Related Cases are consolidated for all pre-trial purposes (the “Consolidated
20   Action”) pursuant to Fed. R. Civ. P. 42(a).
21          2.      To ensure consistent and efficient adjudications in this Court, the “Consolidated
22   Action” will bear Lead Case 3:25-cv-07947-CRB, the number assigned to the first-filed case and
23   reflect the following caption:

             3.      The case file for the Consolidated Action will be maintained under Lead Case No.
 5
     3:25-cv-07947-CRB (the “Lead Case”). When a pleading is intended to apply to all actions to
 6
     which this Order applies, the words “All Actions” shall appear immediately after the words “This
 7
     Document Relates To:” in the caption described above. When a pleading is not intended to apply
 8
     to all actions, the docket number for each individual action to which the paper is intended to apply
 9
     and the last name of the first-named plaintiff in said action shall appear immediately after the
10
     words “This Document Relates To:” in the caption identified above, e.g., “3:25-cv-07947-
11
     CRB(McPhee).”
12
             4.      Any action subsequently filed in, transferred to, or removed to this Court that arises
13
     out of the same or similar operative facts as the Consolidated Action and is asserted on a class or
14
     representative basis, shall be related to and consolidated with the Consolidated Action for pre-trial
15
     purposes. Plaintiffs and/or Defendants shall file a Notice of Related Cases whenever either
16
     believes that a case that should be consolidated with the Consolidated Action is filed in, transferred
17
     to, or removed to this District.
18
             5.      If the Court determines that any such case is related, the clerk shall:
19
                     (a)       Place a copy of this Order in the separate file for such action;
20
                     (b)       Serve on the plaintiffs’ attorney in the new case a copy of this Order;
21
                     (c)       Direct that this Order be served upon the defendant(s) in the new case; and
22
                     (d)       Make an appropriate entry in the Lead Case’s docket.
23
             6.      Any applications for the appointment of Interim Lead Counsel pursuant to Federal
24
     Rule of Civil Procedure 23(g) shall be filed within 10 days from the date on which an order on this
25
     stipulation is entered.
26
             7.      Plaintiffs shall file a Consolidated Class Action Complaint within 45 days after the
27
     Court appoints Interim Lead Counsel or approves consolidation, whichever is latest, which shall
28
     be the operative complaint in the Consolidated Action and shall supersede all previous complaints
